# Arctura Network

Canonical: https://arctura.network/
Role: Open-source ARM subnet implementation and network discovery surface
Updated: 2026-08-18

## Verified status

Arctura's validator and miner implementation has been exercised on Bittensor testnet netuid 505. Local handoff evidence records mandate issuance, miner attestation, scoring, and a successful testnet weight commit.

Arctura is not currently represented as a live Bittensor Finney subnet. No mainnet netuid is published. Mainnet remains gated by a sustained evidence report and explicit operator approval.

## Related properties

- ARM technical reference: https://autonomousresourcemanagement.com/
- Base Sepolia gateway: https://base.arctura.network/
- Knowledge archive: https://arctura.org/
- Source: https://github.com/bittensaur/arctura-base-subnet

These are related properties with distinct roles, not alternate identities.
